newsitem.title: USA: Thermo sees Q1 EPS beating estimates.
newsitem.headline: Thermo sees Q1 EPS beating estimates.

text.p: Thermo Instrument Systems Inc said Tuesday it expects its first quarter earnings to beat Wall Street estimates by at least 10 percent.
The average estimate for earnings per share by stock analysts, as reported by First Call, is $0.30 for the quarter ended March 29, Thermo said in a statement.

Operating income for the quarter is expected to rise by about 60 percent over the same period a year ago, excluding the effects of a nonrecurring charge of $3.5 million to operating income in the 1996 period, Thermo said.
The company intends to announce its first quarter earnings on May 7.

Thermo, based in Waltham, Mass., develops, manufactures and markets analytical instruments used to identify complex chemical compounds, toxic metals and other elements in a broad range of liquids and solids.
